id./param/scenario/cs/c_010_cs_050.pack|cs_:
"Welcome, Luminary {var:1}.
  I'm glad to receive you once more.

"Deceived by Jasper, I long believed the
  Luminary was the Devil's Child,
  bringer of calamity, but...

"{var:1}, you struck down Jasper and
  brought back my daughter Jade.
  Thanks to you, I've finally awakened.

"There is someone I want you to meet.
  Right, Hendrik?

"{var:1}... {var:1}!
  It's me! Your childhood friend, Gemma!

"Thank goodness, {var:1}... you're safe.
  I only heard awful rumors...
  I... I...

"...It was right after you left for the castle.
  A general named Jasper brought a
  large force of soldiers to Cobblestone.

"That general with cold, heartless eyes
  gathered us in the village square
  and ordered his soldiers: kill them all.

"...But General Hendrik arrived late,
  stopped Jasper, and sheltered us.

"We were shut in the castle for a long time,
  but they learned you're the true Luminary
  and let us out.

"{var:1}... you really did well.
  Grandpa in heaven would surely
  be happy to see you now.

"Now, Luminary {var:1}.
  It was short notice, so it's no great
  feast, but enjoy yourselves tonight.

"Hear me, all of you!
  From this day, {var:1} is acknowledged
  as the true Luminary, and shall be praised!
The feast went on late into the night.

Some sang, some danced,
praising {var:1} and friends' deeds.
